resources.string: SmartCart can open %1$s and fill in your pickup, drop and ride type. It uses Android\'s Accessibility service only while a task you approved is running.
SmartCart can open %1$s and search for and add the items you approve. It uses Android\'s Accessibility service only while a task you approved is running.
Read %1$s screens only during a task you approved
Set pickup, drop and ride type
Search, select items and set quantities
Show every step and stop if anything looks unexpected
Ask you before any high-risk change (like a different address or item)
Pay, or enter card, UPI or bank details
Enter OTPs, passwords, CAPTCHAs or use your fingerprint/face
Read other apps, messages or notifications
You can stop any task instantly with the Stop button at the top of the screen, or turn this off at any time in Settings → Connected apps.
After you allow this, Android asks you to turn on SmartCart under Settings → Accessibility. In this mock build no accessibility service is installed, so this step is simulated.
I allow SmartCart to automate %1$s as described
No thanks, I\'ll do it myself
This request is no longer waiting
Estimated total %1$s · final price shown in %2$s
Stops automatically on any unfamiliar screen, sign-in, OTP, CAPTCHA or payment page. Payment always stays with you in %1$s.
If you don\'t answer within %1$d seconds, the task stops safely.
The task was stopped. Anything already added stays in your %1$s cart; nothing else will change.
The approval window passed before the task started. Start again from the comparison.
SmartCart will stop immediately. Items already added stay in the cart.
I checked the %1$s cart and it matches what you approved.
The cart could not be verified. Please check it carefully in %1$s.
Some items were skipped with your OK, so the earlier estimate no longer applies. Check the final price in %1$s.
The final price is shown in %1$s. You review and pay there — SmartCart never pays for you.
In the live app this opens your %1$s cart directly.
%1$s doesn\'t support opening the cart directly, so the app opens on its home screen.
Open %1$s yourself and follow these steps.
This link has now been used. If you need it again, make a new one on this screen.
Links to open your cart work once and for 10 minutes. Make a new one to open the cart.
That cart link has expired or was already used.
You can finish this yourself. Here\'s what to do:
Enter your pickup and drop, and choose the ride type
Search for and add the items below
Check the total, then pay in %1$s
